reason: An AWS Kiro adapter for DeepSeek Harness that exposes Claude and open-weight models through a Kiro account, including credential-file access, token refresh, streaming requests, and optional proxy configuration.

summaries.zh: 将 AWS Kiro 账号接入 DeepSeek Harness，以使用 Kiro 提供的 Claude 和开放权重模型。
summaries.en: Connects an AWS Kiro account to DeepSeek Harness so it can use Claude and open-weight models served by Kiro.

capabilities: Registers a Kiro provider route for DeepSeek Harness
Reads Kiro authentication and device-registration files
Refreshes access tokens in memory when needed
Sends model requests to Kiro endpoints, optionally through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy
Supports streaming model responses and tool schemas
